rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone who carries out work conscientiously and diligently.

example.english: I’m always conscientious about my homework and never hand it in carelessly.

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being careful, thorough, and attentive to details.

example.english: They are conscientious and check every document carefully before the operation.

rows.note: Use this when the person is guided by conscience and has strong moral principles.

example.english: A conscientious businessperson won’t cheat elderly people.
